verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents Insights dashboards that chart BadgerQL query results and can be shared with a team. It also shows errors account-wide across several projects, supports release-scoped queries like `occurred.after:'last deploy'`, and uses deployment tracking to correlate code changes with errors. However, no ready-made trend dashboard is documented: views for top regressions, new issues per release, or error volume over time would have to be built from queries, and it is not explicit that error data feeds Insights charts. Missing for 10: documented built-in error-trend dashboards (top regressions, new-issues-per-release, volume-over-time charts), cross-team rollup views, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time

citations.quote: The Insights UI also lets you chart the results of those queries and add those charts to dashboards that you can share with your team.
Honeybadger can display information from several projects on an account-wide basis, including the following: Errors, Uptime Checks, Check-Ins
Errors that occurred since the most recent deployment
Deployment tracking lets you record when your app is deployed, see a history of deployments, and correlate code changes with errors.
You can search for errors in a single project, or across all projects.
